readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine (at the dinner)
At the moment the temple bell struck nine: his watch showed twenty minutes to nine
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
Uncle's repeater sounded after the thump: ten slow deep notes (the hour strike)
Someone came quickly down the stairs
Bastien Girard came into the library without knocking
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Bastien stopped sitting together in the library

durations: About six minutes between someone going up the stairs (10:15) and coming down (10:21), by Félix's watch
About fourteen minutes between the thump (10:18) and Bastien Girard's arrival (10:32), by Félix's watch
About twenty-eight minutes from Bastien Girard's arrival (10:32 by Félix's watch) until the temple struck eleven, so the two readings come from different timepieces
Félix's father died in 1889 (not an evening duration, so not counted here)
whereabouts: At dinner, Félix was present with his uncle, Aunt Odile, Dr Vauthier, and Girard
After dinner, Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone
In the library, Félix drank several glasses of brandy
Félix did not sit in the salon
Félix stayed alone in the library until Bastien Girard came in at 10:32
Félix was downstairs, below the atelier, when the thump and the repeater sounded
Félix did not see who went up the stairs past the library door at 10:15; the door was shut
Félix did not see who came down at 10:21
The thump was in the atelier, directly above the library
Félix's uncle was up in the atelier with his bench at the time of the thump (per Félix's account)
Bastien Girard came into the library without knocking and sat down
Bastien Girard and Félix sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven
